Written by `Glorbo.EmergencyStop.engage/2` and removed by
`clear/2`. While present, no agent in this company is
dispatched; the sentinel is queried on every wake via
`engaged?/2`. Company-scoped (not agent-scoped).

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `engaged_by`, `engaged_at`

**Optional:** `reason`


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `engaged_by`, `engaged_at`, `reason`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown

engaged_by: director
```
